decision: tolerate_random_loss stays off by default: with a one-BDP queue TCP keeps its share, but with a quarter-BDP queue its median falls 20%, beyond the bar.
bar: With the switch on, the TCP median must not fall below the off range by more than that range width.
superseded: Earlier runs on November 11 set rate and queue on the router netem, whose limit also counts delayed packets; they are replaced by these token-bucket runs.

conditions.workload: routed 7.5 ms RTT; token-bucket bottleneck of 1000 Mbit/s on each outer namespace egress with queue_packets x 1500 bytes; one bridged QinQ flow each way offered 1 Gbit/s through the tunnel with four workers; one netcat TCP CUBIC stream left to right through the same bottleneck
conditions.order: for each of three repeats: off then on, fresh daemons
conditions.units: Mbit/s of inner goodput (tunnel) or TCP payload
